title: A geometric approach to exponentially small splitting: The generic zero-Hopf bifurcation of co-dimension two
summary: In this paper, we consider the unfolding of the real-analytic and generic zero-Hopf bifurcation of co-dimension two. It is well-known that in an open set of parameter space the splitting of one-dimensional stable and unstable manifolds is beyond all orders. This paper provides a new geometric dynamical-systems-oriented proof for the exponentially small splitting. As a novel aspect, we relate the exponentially small splitting to the lack of analyticity of center-like manifolds of generalized saddle-nodes.
